### Release - Minecraft 1.21.11

#### Highlights

- Dragon Profit HUD with bazaar / lowest-BIN pricing, kill-source attribution (summoned vs lootshare), and eye-cost-adjusted per-kill profit.
- Dragon-down chat announcements — Legion stats and dragon profit summary, with party-chat / local-only routing and 500 ms delay so they don't break Hypixel's DRAGON DOWN block.
- Right-click in chat to copy a message — Shift for the single visible line, Ctrl to preserve §-color codes.
- [Soul] prefix on outgoing party-chat announcements (toggle in General → Chat, default on).

#### Fixes & improvements

- Dragon Profit HUD: split header (Dragons / LS counts + Eyes Placed with cost), per-dragon average chip, Profit hover tooltip with gross / eye-cost breakdown.
- Recovered Summoning Eyes now decrement the pending count for accurate eye-cost math.
- Travel Scroll to Dragon's Nest catalog entry corrected.
- "Old Dragon profit" wording in chat announcement (was "Old profit").
- Crash fix when switching the Source filter to Lootshare.
- Multi-line hover tooltips supported on Soul HUDs.

Release - Minecraft 1.21.11

  Highlights

  - Hide vanilla status effects.
  - Fishing Festival countdown integrated into Fishing HUD.

  Fixes & improvements

  - Removed standalone Fishing Festival HUD.
  - New dev action to reset HUD defaults.
  - Various HUD default adjustments.

Release - Minecraft 1.21.11

  Highlights

  - 3×3 anchor grid in /soul gui.
  - Per-HUD style overrides.
  - Use Minecraft Font.
  - Welcome landing page.
  - About → Used Software.
  - Fishing tracker UX upgrades.

  Fixes & improvements

  - Bobbin Time / Legion boost formula fixed (additive stacking across armor pieces).
  - Text shadow rewrite with configurable size slider.
  - Bold font default; Inter Bold + Black bundled.
  - GUI-Scale-independent screens.
  - /soul gui help dialog + Reset HUD shortcut.
  - Default global scale bumped 1.5 → 1.65.
  - Use Minecraft Font respects scrollable list bounds.
  - Fishing tracker counter rollup (DH/Cocoons into Catches).

  One-time HUD layout reset

  gui_layout.json is wiped on first launch of 3.1.0 — the new 9-point anchor system stores enum fields old files don't have. Custom HUD
  positions will need to be set again via /soul gui.
